newsitem.title: UK: Edinburgh Inv plans 100 mln stg debenture.
newsitem.headline: Edinburgh Inv plans 100 mln stg debenture.

text.p: Edinburgh Investment Trust Plc said on Wednesday it was planning to issue a new 25 year 100 million sterling debenture stock issue shortly.
The new issue will bring total long-term borrowings to 200 million sterling and give the company a maximum potential gearing in line with a number of other large investment trusts, it said.

"The board believes that interest rates are currently at an attractive level for borrowers," it said. As with the existing debenture, half of the interest cost will be taken to the capital account and half to revenue.

It said that all the funds raised from the new debenture stock would not necessarily be invested immediately but may be held in cash and short-term interest bearing securities until better opportunities arise.
The company said net assets rose by 9.7 percent in the year to end-March compared to a rise of 13.8 percent in the FT-SE Actuaries All-Share Index.

The shortfall against the index was due mainly to overseas holdings, since sold, and the costs involved in switching out of fixed interest stocks and concentrating the UK equity portfolio on companies offering dividend growth along with the potential for greater capital appreciation.
It announced a total dividend for the year of 10.75 pence,
